The '''Ghost Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] and a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] that blocked light from most of the [[Star/Legends|stars]] beyond and within it, isolating it from the galaxy and inspiring its name. [[Ultraviolet/Legends|Ultraviolet]] radiation from massive stars at its center ionized the surrounding gases to form [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]], which bathed the planets within the nebula in their ultraviolet light. It surrounded the inhabited [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] and [[Atoa/Legends|Atoa]], respective [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworlds]] of the [[near-Human]]s [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] and [[Atoan]] peoples.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] the nebula was considered a vital (though isolated) supply route, and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] fought against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]]-aligned [[Umbaran militia]] for control of their homeworld. After the [[Declaration of a New Order|creation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Atoan system]] was conquered after a [[Atoan insurgency|failed rebellion]] led by the traitorous [[Garoche Tarkin]] and local insurgents.
